summary: Describes how clients of the Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP) can authenticate using OpenID Connect, so one login at an identity provider can be used with many RDAP servers. This lets servers make access control decisions based on who the client is, without a separate account at each server.

eli5.summary: Instead of showing a different ID card at every door, you show one trusted card. This lets users log in once and look up domain owner information at many places.
